'''Vo Tunbren''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tadra sector/Legends|Tadra sector]] a subsector of the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the location of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] communications research facility where [[Jeres Moridon]] was stationed.
